text:
maya: Heads-up: planning to enable polaris-7b-v2 in the model catalog on 2026-03-25T22:00Z UTC. Need to agree fallback ordering, canary split, and enterprise pin policy.

sasha: +1. What's the proposed fallback ladder?

maya: Thinking: prefer polaris-7b-v2, then polaris-7b (non-v2), then polaris-quant as last resort. Also want a hard pin option for enterprise tenants.

kevin: For enterprise, we'll need a stable pin target. Suggest creating alias enterprise/polaris-7b-legacy that maps to polaris-7b (not v2). Ops teams can request pinning per account.

jon: We'll need a short blurb in release notes about behavior change: new default = v2, but legacy customers keep existing model unless pinned. I'll draft.

maya: Proposed fallback config (for deploybot to accept):
```
fallback_order:
  - polaris-7b-v2
  - polaris-7b
  - polaris-quant
pinning_exceptions:
  enterprise_alias: enterprise/polaris-7b-legacy
  allow_manual_pin: true
```

sasha: Canary plan: global 5% traffic to v2 for 30m, EU region 10% for 30m. Monitor p50/p95/p99 latency and error rate. If p99 > 250ms OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, auto rollback.

ops-oncall: FYI oncall: I'm available for the window. Please notify 15m before cutover so I can free the channel.

deploybot: :robot_face: Catalog change job queued: job_id=cbf-20260325-01, scheduled_at=2026-03-25T22:00:00Z UTC. Preflight tasks: model checksum, weights validated, GPU placement OK.

deploybot: Preflight result: weights OK, compatibility tests OK, sample inference latency baseline vs current: p99 delta +12ms. No blockers.

kevin: One ask — can we exclude customers with active compliance reviews from the auto-swap? They need to remain on legacy until signoff.

maya: Good call. We'll add a customer tag exclusion: skip_swap_if tag=compliance_review. deploybot, include that in run.

deploybot: Noted. Updated job config to include exclusion tag filter.

jon: Release notes: added paragraph about enterprise alias and how to request pins + rollback criteria. I'll push draft to the docs repo now.

maya: Rollback thresholds to codify in the runbook:
- p99 latency increase > 200ms absolute or >25% relative for 10m
- error rate > 0.5% for 5m
- quality regression: eval prompts CTR drop > 3% for canary set (manual check)
If triggered: immediate traffic revert to previous fallback target and notify eng-sre + product.

sasha: Can we add an automatic gradual ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 90m if stable? That helps catch slow regressions.

maya: Yes, ramp plan accepted: 5% (30m) -> 25% (30m) -> 50% (30m). Any anomalies at any stage triggers hold or rollback.

ops-oncall: Reminder: ensure metric dashboards are pinned to the thread and alert thresholds match the runbook. I'll own oncall alerts.

deploybot: :robot_face: On approval, run will: 1) create canary slice, 2) apply fallback_order for global routing, 3) apply enterprise pins per alias mapping, 4) schedule ramp. Job ID cbf-20260325-01.

kevin: Approving as long as enterprise pins and exclusion tags are honored. :thumbsup:

jon: Approving docs/notes. I'll add a short 'how to pin' snippet.

maya: Approving deploy timeline. Last check: QA signoff?

sasha: QA completed against canary prompts, no regressions found. :eyes: ready for canary.

maya: OK launching pre-cutover announce now to #customer-notify and legal for compliance exception heads up. Notify me in this thread 15m before start.

deploybot: :robot_face: Scheduled notification posted to #customer-notify for 2026-03-25T21:45:00Z UTC.

ops-oncall: Got it. Will join channel at 21:45Z and monitor.

maya: Thanks team. If we see anything unexpected we fallback to polaris-7b and roll forward planning after postmortem.

sasha: Quick command for ops: rollout status check -> `curl -s https://deploy-api.internal/v1/jobs/cbf-20260325-01/status`

kevin: One more: ensure billing tags don't change for pinned customers — finance asked to keep billing class same.

maya: Added billing_preserve: true to job config.

deploybot: Config snapshot attached to job cbf-20260325-01. All requested options applied. Ready to execute on schedule.

jon: Will push the release note link here once live.

maya: Perfect. Thread closed unless any last-minute objections. :thumbsup:
